newsitem.title: BULGARIA: WEATHER FORECAST - BULGARIA - AUGUST 14 - SUNNY.
newsitem.headline: WEATHER FORECAST - BULGARIA - AUGUST 14 - SUNNY.

text.p: Sunny with cloudy spells across the country rain possible in the southeast and in the mountains, state radio said.
Maximum temperatures are expected between 25 and 30 degrees, temperature in Sofia is seen at about 25 degrees.
Air temperatures along the Black Sea coast are expected between 22 and 23 degrees. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-91188
